summary: Structural twin of RGBToLuminanceByte (005087A2) that writes a 16-bit texel per vertex instead of a single byte. When this+0x1048 is set, a4 is first replaced by the DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion result. Computes a tile base at this+0x2C offset by the (a2,a3) 4x4 block position, calls UtilityFunction_7473, then for each of this+0x1058 vertices builds a word whose low byte is the BT.709 luminance of the RGB floats at a4 (+8,+4,+0) scaled by 255 and whose high byte is the alpha channel float at a4+12 scaled by 255, both added to the tile value at +4*(v4&3). Returns the conversion-state global dword_8B009C.

local_names.v5: result of DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion, reassigned to a4
local_names.v6: tile base pointer at this+0x2C plus the encoded block offset
local_names.v7: output word pointer (advances per written vertex)
local_names.v8: byte offset into the source vertex array (advances 16 per vertex)
local_names.v9: 16-bit value assembled from luminance (low) and alpha (high) bytes

operations.description: Guard on this[1042] (offset 0x1048): when non-zero, call DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion(this, a4) and replace a4 with its returned pointer.
Compute tile base pointer v6 = this[11] (offset 0x2C) + 4 * ((a3 & 3) + 8 * (a2 & 3)); this encodes a 4x4 color block position from the masked (a2,a3) indices.
Call UtilityFunction_7473() unconditionally before the vertex loop.

If this[1046] (offset 0x1058 vertex count) is non-zero, do-while loop over v4: compute v12 = (float at a4+v8+8 * 0.0721 + float at a4+v8+4 * 0.7154 + float at a4+v8 * 0.2125) * 255 + float at v6+4*(v4&3), and v11 = float at a4+v8+12 * 255 + float at v6+4*(v4&3); assemble the word with low byte (int)v12 and high byte (int)v11, write *v7++, advance v8 by 16; repeat while v4 < this+0x1058.
Return dword_8B009C (conversion-state global) as the function result.
